paper_title: Tur[k]ingBench A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents
caption: Distribution of errors in a single run of GPT4 across all tasks
model_annotation: The figure titled “Distribution of Errors with GPT-4” shows a donut (ring) pie chart summarizing the categorical breakdown of outcomes/errors for a single GPT‑4 run across tasks, with each slice labeled by category and percentage. There are no axes. The largest slice is a blue segment labeled “Incorrect” with an external callout on the right indicating 43.6%. A large red segment labeled “Correct” has an external callout on the lower left indicating 31.6%. On the left side, three mid-to-small slices have callouts with leader lines: a yellow slice labeled “Partial” at 11.3%, a green slice labeled “Syntax Error” at 2.3%, and an orange slice labeled “Unknown” at 8.3% (the orange slice also contains the text “Unknown” inside the segment). Near the top-left/top area are two very small slices with callouts: a light gray/blue slice labeled “Bad Response” at 1.5%, and a very small pale/light slice labeled “Unknown” at 1.5%. The chart includes small circular anchor points where leader lines touch slices, and category names are placed inside larger slices while smaller categories are primarily labeled via external callouts.
